solutions.check: grid rebuilt from the blog's light list (unique); every answer written into it with each crossing agreeing

clue.text: Union leader ousted in delay

indicators.note: the leading letter of the synonym for delay is thrown out

parts.note: to dally is to delay, so dalliance is delay or time-wasting

explanation.surface: A trade union boss is removed while negotiations drag on.
explanation.definitionFit: A union of parties or nations for a common purpose is a synonym.

clue.text: Risk everything to attack man that's changed sides

parts.note: to go for someone is to attack them

indicators.note: left swaps over to right, so the L of the word becomes an R

parts.note: bloke is informal British for a man

explanation.surface: A gambler stakes all on assaulting a turncoat.
explanation.walkthrough: 'that's changed sides' turns BLOKE's L (left) into R (right), making BROKE.
explanation.definitionFit: The idiom means to stake all one has on a single venture.

clue.text: She succeeded to hold line without any issue

indicators.note: the female successor's word holds the extra letter inside it

parts.note: a woman who succeeds to an inheritance is an heiress

explanation.surface: A woman who inherited the throne kept the royal line going without children.
explanation.definitionFit: Issue means offspring, so having no children leaves one with no successor.

clue.text: Mark needing book on language, skipping the introduction

indicators.note: the opening letter of the language's name is left out

parts.note: Flemish is the Dutch language spoken in Belgium

explanation.surface: A grade earned by a book about a language, once you leave out the opening chapter.
explanation.definitionFit: A blemish is a stain or flaw, a synonym of mark as a noun.

clue.text: Essentially hallucinated about work involving curvaceous characters?

indicators.note: about signals the core letters being rearranged
the essence of the word is its core, the letters left once the outer ones go

explanation.surface: Someone essentially imagined things while working on a manuscript.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Essentially' takes the central LUCINA of hallucinated, and 'about' rearranges it.
explanation.definitionFit: This is a manuscript written in the rounded majuscule script of early medieval scribes.

clue.text: Call sign of union?

definitions.meaning: to telephone someone, give them a bell
a wedding band worn as a token of marriage

explanation.definitionFit: Ring means to telephone, and a wedding band symbolises a marriage union.

clue.text: My unknown dog's not hard

parts.note: Z is one of the algebraic unknowns

indicators.note: not removes the letter for hard from the dogs

parts.note: read as dogs, plural, which are hounds
H is the pencil abbreviation for hard

explanation.surface: Someone complains that their mystery dog is not tough.
explanation.walkthrough: 'My' looks like a possessive but is the exclamation of surprise.
explanation.definitionFit: Both are old-fashioned exclamations of surprise or indignation.

clue.text: Free love over in London college

indicators.note: in places the two letters within the college's initials

parts.note: LSE is the London School of Economics
love is nil in tennis, the letter O
O is the cricket abbreviation for over

explanation.surface: Romance is finished at a university in London.
explanation.definitionFit: Loose and free are synonyms meaning not confined or tied up.

clue.text: Victor runs away from unusually revolting freckles

indicators.note: unusually says the remaining letters are rearranged
these letters go away from the following word

parts.note: R is the cricket abbreviation for runs
Victor is V in the NATO alphabet

explanation.surface: A man named Victor flees from something unusually disgusting: freckles.
explanation.walkthrough: 'away from' takes V and R from REVOLTING, leaving EOLTING, which 'unusually' rearranges.
explanation.definitionFit: Lentigo is the medical term for freckles or small pigmented skin spots.

clue.text: Letters missing in this post offce mail delivered around Greece

indicators.note: the rearranged letters go around the abbreviation
delivered as in freed or released, so the letters are rearranged

parts.note: PO is post office (the misspelling is the setter's joke: it is missing a letter)
GR is the abbreviation for Greece

explanation.surface: A complaint that letters went missing at a post office whose mail goes around Greece.
explanation.walkthrough: 'delivered' is the anagram signal and 'around' the container signal. The printed 'offce' lacks its I: a small example of the device itself.
explanation.definitionFit: A lipogram is a text written deliberately avoiding one or more letters.

clue.text: Green Man pub sheltering graduate cleaned out by university

indicators.note: the pub word shelters the letters inside it

parts.note: an inn is a pub

indicators.note: the word is emptied of its middle, leaving its outer letters

explanation.surface: The Green Man is a pub housing a graduate who was cleaned out by his university.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Green Man' looks like a pub name but is the definition; 'cleaned out' leaves GE from graduate.
explanation.definitionFit: An ingenu is a naive, inexperienced young man, so green as in callow.

clue.text: Available after swapping partner that's impotent

indicators.note: in bridge North and South are partners, so one compass letter swaps for the other

parts.note: usable means available for use

explanation.surface: A person who is free after leaving their partner proves impotent.
explanation.walkthrough: In bridge North and South play as partners, so S is swapped for N.
explanation.definitionFit: Impotent means powerless or incapable, a synonym of not able.

clue.text: Starts to console injured suitor after single maiden's gaffe

indicators.note: the initials come after the word for single

parts.note: sole means single or only

indicators.note: the starts are the first letters of the three words

parts.note: M is the cricket abbreviation for a maiden over

explanation.surface: A suitor's blunder after a lone girl's error, starting to console him once hurt.
explanation.definitionFit: A solecism is a blunder in grammar or etiquette, a social slip.

clue.text: Supreme commander, mostly instinctive, presiding over one US city

indicators.note: in a down clue the earlier pieces sit above the letter for one

parts.note: CINC is short for commander-in-chief

indicators.note: most of the word, losing its last letter

parts.note: innate means inborn or instinctive
I is the Roman numeral one

explanation.surface: A top military leader, acting on instinct, takes charge of a single American city.
explanation.definitionFit: Cincinnati is a city in Ohio, United States.

clue.text: Bighead, finally undone, is caught out

indicators.note: finally takes the last letter of the word
the word for caught sits out, around the other letters

parts.note: got means caught, as in got the ball

explanation.surface: A conceited person is finally undone, caught out.
explanation.walkthrough: 'finally' picks the last letter of undone; 'out' is the container signal, saying the word for caught sits outside the rest.
explanation.definitionFit: A bighead is a conceited person, one preoccupied with self.

clue.text: Rule about addict that once made a dash?

indicators.note: about turns the word for rule backwards

parts.note: law means a rule
a nut is an enthusiast or fanatic

explanation.surface: A regulation about addicts, which once made a dash for it.
explanation.walkthrough: 'dash' is short for dashboard: classic cars had polished veneer ones of this wood.
explanation.definitionFit: Walnut veneer was the classic wood for luxury car dashboards.

clue.text: If emptied sample went missing, this star would be at risk

definitions.text: If emptied sample went missing, this star would be at risk

parts.words: If emptied sample went missing, this star would be at risk
parts.note: emptying sample leaves its outer letters S and E; take those from the starred symbol and the phrase at risk remains

explanation.surface: A warning that a celebrity would be endangered if a test sample were lost.
explanation.walkthrough: Remove SE ('sample' emptied) from the answer and AT RISK is left.
explanation.definitionFit: The star-shaped printing symbol is a typographical mark.

clue.text: Believer in divine wisdom hopes to convert hearts

indicators.note: convert means change, so the letters are rearranged

parts.note: H is the card abbreviation for hearts

explanation.surface: A spiritual person hopes to convert hearts to the faith.
explanation.definitionFit: A theosoph is a follower of theosophy, which claims mystical knowledge of the divine.

clue.text: Black snake's left inside bag

indicators.note: the letter for left goes inside the other pieces

parts.note: B is the pencil abbreviation for black
an adder is a snake

explanation.surface: A dark snake was left inside a bag.
explanation.definitionFit: A bladder is an inflatable bag, as in a football's.

clue.text: With this hammered, you'd secure water-line

definitions.text: With this hammered, you'd secure water-line

indicators.note: hammered means beaten out of shape, so the letters are rearranged

explanation.surface: Drive this peg home and the hull will be sound at the water-line.
explanation.walkthrough: W (with) plus the answer, rearranged, gives WATERLINE; the clue also describes the peg holding a ship's planks.
explanation.definitionFit: A treenail is a wooden peg used to fasten planking to a ship's frame.

clue.text: Bring to light amoral chap's past

parts.note: a rake is a dissolute man
up means over or finished, as in time's up

explanation.surface: Uncover a playboy's history.
explanation.definitionFit: To rake up is to revive or expose something long forgotten.

clue.text: Lord to some, a noble European's excellent

parts.note: don is a Spanish title of nobility
A1 means first-rate, written AI

explanation.surface: Some call him lord: a noble from Europe is excellent.
explanation.definitionFit: Adonai is a Hebrew name for God used in Jewish worship.

clue.text: Capital of Ethiopia having no house refurbished

indicators.note: refurbished means made over, so the remaining letters are rearranged
the letters for house are removed from the word

explanation.surface: The capital city of Ethiopia has no house refurbished.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Capital of Ethiopia' looks like Addis Ababa; 'having no' takes HO out, and 'refurbished' rearranges ETIPIA.
explanation.definitionFit: Taipei is the capital city of Taiwan.

clue.text: King, one occupying podium with hands on hips?

indicators.note: the letters occupy the space inside the podium word

parts.note: an ambo is a raised pulpit in early churches
K is the chess abbreviation for king
I is the Roman numeral one

explanation.surface: A monarch on a podium strikes a pose with hands on hips.
explanation.definitionFit: Arms akimbo means hands on hips with elbows turned outwards.

clue.text: HRH regularly snubbed Michael Barrymore

indicators.note: letters are dropped at regular intervals, keeping one in every four

explanation.surface: A royal regularly ignored the TV entertainer Michael Barrymore.
explanation.walkthrough: Keep every fourth letter: M, A, A, M. Michael Barrymore was a British TV host.
explanation.definitionFit: Ma'am is the form of address used for a royal highness after first greeting.

clue.text: Shadow cast by cape on front of decorative chest

indicators.note: takes the first letter of the word

parts.note: an ark is a chest, as in the Ark of the Covenant
ness is a headland or cape

explanation.surface: A cape casts a shadow on an ornate chest.
explanation.definitionFit: Darkness and shadow are synonyms for the absence of light.

clue.text: Unexpected conflict dividing unknown number in middle- eastern states

indicators.note: the word for conflict splits the other letters
the letter goes in the abbreviation for the states

parts.note: UAE is the United Arab Emirates
N is an unknown number in algebra
war is conflict

explanation.surface: An unforeseen war splits a nation in the Middle East.
explanation.walkthrough: 'in' and 'dividing' are both container signals: the unknown goes in first, then conflict splits the result after its third letter. The definition works as in 'caught unaware'.
explanation.definitionFit: Taken unaware means without warning, as in an unforeseen event.

clue.text: Bang up following nonsense after one's dismissal

indicators.note: the up comes after the shortened nonsense
dismissal means the letter for one is sent away

parts.note: vulgar slang for rubbish or nonsense
I is the Roman numeral one
taken as written

explanation.surface: Jailed after some rubbish led to someone getting sacked.
explanation.definitionFit: Shtup is vulgar Yiddish-derived slang for having sex.
